items.title: Is Lululemon Athletica (LULU) About To Cut Its 2026 Outlook?
items.summary: Lululemon Athletica (NasdaqGS:LULU) is expected to cut its fiscal 2026 outlook following weaker sales trends in the US and China. UBS Securities highlighted the pressure in these key markets and flagged a possible downward revision to the long term forecast. The prospect of a reduced outlook has raised fresh questions about Lululemon Athletica's future growth plans in its largest regions.
